preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of operations m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid nodes and cannot form cycles.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in operations)
preconditions.description: All operations must specify valid nodes and cannot target the same node.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(c) <= n-1 for c in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output integer must represent a valid count of common numbers between nodes.
